offers_products.reason: Offerings are PEO, payroll, HR, insurance and staffing services; the myBBSI HRIS platform is bundled in.

offers_services.reason: Payroll administration, HR consulting, workers' comp and risk management, benefits, and staffing and recruiting for client businesses.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are business owners buying payroll, HR, benefits and staffing; no individual or household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells PEO, staffing and workers' comp services to businesses in construction, healthcare, hospitality, transportation and more.

recurring_revenue.reason: PEO clients are billed every payroll cycle under ongoing service relationships, covering payroll, workers' comp and benefits.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payroll, HR compliance and workers' comp are needed to operate; though staffing and headcount-based fees fall in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Payroll, HR and workers' comp services are billed continually each pay cycle, not as large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Dedicated local payroll, HR and safety specialists plus placed staff are the core of the service delivered.

large_customers.reason: Targets small and mid-sized businesses ('delivering locally supported solutions for small businesses') across construction, hospitality and other industries.

asset_heavy.reason: PEO, payroll, HR and staffing services run on staff and an HRIS platform, without plants or fleets.

notes: Software (myBBSI HRIS) is a platform bundled into the PEO service, not sold separately as a main product.
